title: NormalSource
description: Where a LitMaterial takes its surface normals from. An object rather than a name, so a source carries its own parameters and a user can add one: anything that produces a tangent-space normal texture - derived from a height map, from two photographs, from a generator - is a valid source without this package knowing about it.
